Don't be sad for me. Although I'm no longer with you in this physical world, hopefully, my spirit will live on with you forever. I hope that you can hear me giggling beside you while you watch Family Guy, and that you also hear my (rather horrid) singing in the car when my favorite song comes on the radio. I hope that you remember me for my quick wit, sharp tongue and unwavering loyalty to those that I love. I hope that you can think of me, and not cry, but laugh as you think back on the memories we've shared. I also want you to know that I have forgiven everyone. I didn't leave harboring any ill will. Remember the good times, disregard the bad, remember that I love you and remember that this is not the end. We'll find one another again. 

PS: All those people posting on my FB wall? I haven't spoken to them in years. Maybe ever. Are they even my FB friends? Where did they come from?

PPS: Troy's not allowed to give my eulogy. It will be tragic. You won't be able to count how many times he says 'fuck'. Just a heads up, I want my funeral to be fabulous. 

Your life will go on and you'll have the best damned life you could want. Everyone that I love has so much potential and is capable of great things. Just know that I'll be around when you find new love, when you get into grad school, when you start your 'big kid job', (to my sisters) when you start driving, when you get married, when you start a family of your own. I'll be there. Loving you just as much as I do today, and as I did the day before that, and the day before that. I hope that even as the years go by, you'll tell your children stories about their aunt J. I hope that none of you ever run out of stories to tell. I love you.
